name: Ethique Eco-Friendly Solid Shampoo Bar
description: Transform your hair care routine with this concentrated, zero-waste shampoo bar that replaces up to three plastic bottles. Crafted from naturally derived ingredients, it leaves your hair soft, shiny, and fully nourished.

name: Bite Toothpaste Bits
description: Say goodbye to plastic tubes with these revolutionary toothpaste tablets that naturally whiten and protect your teeth. Simply bite, brush with a wet toothbrush, and enjoy a refreshing minty smile every morning.

name: Leaf Shave Reusable Safety Razor
description: Experience the smoothest shave of your life with this beautifully engineered, plastic-free safety razor. Its pivoting head and multi-blade design provide a luxurious, eco-friendly alternative to disposable razors.

name: Marley's Monsters Reusable Cotton Rounds
description: Ditch single-use cotton pads for these luxuriously soft, reusable facial rounds made from 100% cotton flannel. Perfect for applying toner or removing makeup, they can be tossed right into the wash for endless reuse.

name: Dental Lace Refillable Silk Floss
description: Keep your smile radiant with this 100% compostable silk dental floss wrapped in a beautifully designed refillable glass container. It glides effortlessly between teeth to remove plaque while leaving absolutely no microplastics behind.

name: Brush with Bamboo Plant-Based Toothbrush
description: Upgrade your daily brushing with this fully plant-based toothbrush featuring a sustainably harvested bamboo handle. Soft, castor-bean oil bristles ensure a gentle clean for your teeth and the planet.
